styles.name: seedling
styles.description: Five discrete growth stages: seed → sprout → stem → leaves → flower, driven by progress

styles.name: fern-fiddlehead
styles.description: A fern fiddlehead unrolls from a tight coil into an open frond as progress advances

styles.name: bamboo-shoot
styles.description: Bamboo culm grows segment by segment upward; joints appear at each node as progress rises

styles.name: ivy-trellis
styles.description: Ivy climbs a dot-grid trellis left-to-right; curling tendrils spiral off the vine

styles.name: cactus-arms
styles.description: A cactus trunk rises then sprouts a left arm, right arm, and finally spines at full growth

styles.name: sunflower-seeds
styles.description: Sunflower disc fills with golden-angle phyllotaxis seeds radiating from the centre

styles.name: mushroom-cap
styles.description: A mushroom stalk rises then its dome cap expands; spore dots drift downward

styles.name: succulent-rosette
styles.description: A succulent rosette opens radially; leaves widen and extend as progress advances

styles.name: root-system
styles.description: Fractal root branches grow downward from a taproot; depth and density increase with progress

styles.name: bonsai
styles.description: A bonsai forms: trunk rises, branches fork in tiers, then canopy foliage fills in
